_comment: R34 prototype display hints; belongs in the pack later. Geographic furniture only, never control or movement. Region anchors and crossing locations are approximate. City street plans are emblems, not invented roads. R35: silhouette bands select actual contour endpoints; corridor names are broad display hints, never a terrain boundary.
